fullPassage:
Notice to Hilltop Apartment Residents
In accordance with fire safety regulations, it is essential to keep all hallways free of personal belongings such as bicycles, boxes, and small furniture. Hallways serve as critical evacuation routes during emergencies, and anything left there could block the way and pose serious safety risks. To ensure the safety of all residents, we request that any personal items placed in the hallways be removed by Monday, April 14th. Please note that not following this may result in penalties. We appreciate your cooperation in maintaining a safe environment.

questions.passage: Notice to Hilltop Apartment Residents In (A)[accordance / violation] with fire safety regulations, it is (B)[essential / unnecessary] to keep all hallways free of personal belongings such as bicycles, boxes, and small furniture. Hallways serve as critical (C)[evacuation / decoration] routes during emergencies, and anything left there could block the way and pose serious safety risks. To ensure the safety of all residents, we request that any personal items placed in the hallways be removed by Monday, April 14th. Please note that not following this may result in penalties. We appreciate your cooperation in maintaining a safe environment.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 화재 안전 규정에 (A)따라(accordance) 복도를 개인 소지품 없이 유지하는 것이 (B)필수적(essential)이다. 복도는 비상시 중요한 (C)대피(evacuation) 경로 역할을 한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① accordance — essential — evacuation: 원문과 일치 ←정답
❌ ② violation(위반): accordance(일치, 준수)의 반의어
❌ ③ unnecessary(불필요한): essential(필수적인)의 반의어
❌ ④ decoration(장식): evacuation(대피)과 의미가 전혀 다름
det.tip: in accordance with = ~에 따라 / essential = 필수적인 / evacuation = 대피

questions.passage: Notice to Hilltop Apartment Residents In accordance with fire safety regulations, it is essential to keep all hallways free of personal belongings such as bicycles, boxes, and small furniture. Hallways serve as critical evacuation routes during emergencies, and anything left there could (A)[block / clear] the way and (B)[pose / eliminate] serious safety risks. To ensure the safety of all residents, we request that any personal items placed in the hallways be (C)[removed / installed] by Monday, April 14th. Please note that not following this may result in penalties. We appreciate your cooperation in maintaining a safe environment.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 복도에 놓인 물건은 통로를 (A)막고(block) 심각한 안전 위험을 (B)초래(pose)할 수 있다. 개인 물품을 (C)치워(removed) 달라고 요청한다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① block — eliminate — removed: (B) eliminate(제거하다)는 pose(초래하다)와 반대 방향
❌ ② clear — pose — removed: (A) clear(치우다)는 block(막다)의 반의어
❌ ③ block — pose — installed: (C) installed(설치된)는 removed(제거된)의 반의어
✅ ④ block — pose — removed: 원문과 일치 ←정답
det.tip: block the way = 길을 막다 / pose risks = 위험을 초래하다 / remove = 제거하다

questions.passage: Notice to Hilltop Apartment Residents In accordance with fire safety regulations, it is essential to keep all hallways free of personal belongings such as bicycles, boxes, and small furniture. Hallways serve as critical evacuation routes during emergencies, and anything left there could block the way and pose serious safety risks. To (A)[ensure / jeopardize] the safety of all residents, we request that any personal items placed in the hallways be removed by Monday, April 14th. Please note that not following this may result in (B)[penalties / rewards]. We (C)[appreciate / resent] your cooperation in maintaining a safe environment.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 주민 안전을 (A)보장(ensure)하기 위해 물품 제거를 요청한다. 미이행 시 (B)벌칙(penalties)이 부과될 수 있다. 협조에 (C)감사(appreciate)드린다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① jeopardize — penalties — appreciate: (A) jeopardize(위험에 빠뜨리다)는 ensure(보장하다)의 반의어
❌ ② ensure — rewards — appreciate: (B) rewards(보상)는 penalties(벌칙)의 반의어
❌ ③ ensure — penalties — resent: (C) resent(원망하다)는 appreciate(감사하다)의 반의어
✅ ④ ensure — penalties — appreciate: 원문과 일치 ←정답
det.tip: ensure = 보장하다 ↔ jeopardize = 위태롭게 하다 / penalties = 벌칙 ↔ rewards = 보상

To ensure the safety of all residents, we request that any personal items placed in the hallways be removed by Monday, April 14th. Please note that not following this may result in penalties. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③ facilitate(촉진하다) → block(막다): 복도에 놓인 물건은 통로를 '막는' 것이지 '촉진하는' 것이 아니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① regulations(규정): 원문 일치 — fire safety regulations
✅ ② belongings(소지품): 원문 일치 — personal belongings
❌ ③ facilitate(촉진하다): 원문은 block(막다) — 반의어로 교체됨 ←정답
✅ ④ risks(위험): 원문 일치 — safety risks
det.tip: block(막다) ↔ facilitate(촉진하다, 용이하게 하다)

Notice to Hilltop Apartment Residents
In accordance with fire safety regulations, it is essential to keep all hallways free of personal belongings such as bicycles, boxes, and small furniture. Hallways serve as critical evacuation routes during emergencies, and anything left there could block the way and pose serious safety risks. To ensure the safety of all residents, we request that any personal items placed in the hallways be removed by Monday, April 14th. Please note that not following this may result in penalties. We appreciate your __________ in maintaining a safe environment.
